name: agent-engineering-kit
description: Muhammad Ahmad's Claude Code setup as a plugin marketplace: engineering from idea to production (backend, web, mobile), review agents, git safety hooks, plus LinkedIn, ads and video skills. Everything off by default; turn on per project.

plugins.name: ship
plugins.description: Idea to production as plain steps: idea brief, new repo setup, feature research, spec, issues, plan review before code, test-first build, commit check, PR, CI, deploy check, merge gates, release, observe, incident, postmortem, cleanup.

plugins.name: check
plugins.description: Test rules, test-first, writing tests, code review with a separate placement pass, security and privacy review, accessibility audit, performance checks, privacy-safe analytics.

plugins.name: crew
plugins.description: Three review agents that work cold, without your chat: plan-reviewer (before code), code-reviewer (after), test-writer.

plugins.name: server
plugins.description: Server code: layers and rules, contract-first endpoints, safe migrations, scheduled jobs and notifications, file uploads, read-only database checks.

plugins.name: web
plugins.description: Web front ends: structure rules, app screens with every state, content pages with accessibility and performance checks. React/Next.js and Astro notes.

plugins.name: mobile
plugins.description: Mobile apps on any stack: app structure, a shared core for Android and iOS, background work, an offline outbox, design to screen, widgets, real-device testing.

plugins.name: kit
plugins.description: Skills about the kit itself: write a new skill, turn a mistake into a lasting rule, record a decision (ADR).

plugins.name: guard
plugins.description: Two hooks: block a git commit that adds something that looks like a secret, and block commits straight on main or master.

plugins.name: linkedin
plugins.description: LinkedIn in your own voice: posts with hook options, comments, replies, DMs, inbox triage, weekly plan, profile score, carousels, repurposing long content, and a check that strips AI tells. Never posts without your yes.

plugins.name: ads
plugins.description: ChatGPT Ads Manager: research context hints, build and verify campaigns, and prepare CSV ad imports. Never launches or spends without your yes.

plugins.name: video
plugins.description: Short vertical video ads and reels drawn in code, with voiceover, music, sound effects and captions.
